scope: Local integration and flow consistency audit. No external mail or production submissions.

Profile update visible to a separate visitor
File picker uploads and publishes a real association photo
Card/list switching preserves search and filters; browser remembers the selected view
Contact TEB opens the real contact form without submitting a message
Single-step form stays visible while opening the invitation and changing previews
Popup retains the draft and photo after closing; website and print previews show the event
Receipt offers optional local sharing with honest contact placeholders
Guest remains private before approval
TEB approval publishes guest event with the uploaded photo and print request
Actual receipt URL and on-page private status link open the approved event
Approval mail opens public event details
Pending guest revision preserves public version
Member publishes directly through the real API
Association creation stays in its own popup and refreshes the event list
Member publishes news with a real photo and one stable key after a lost successful response
Public profile puts its own name and contact before the fold and displays published news
News detail and Det sker use the same public record without visitor editing controls
Owner filters and searches own content, then edits published news with revisions
Public contact and news editor fit both 390px and 320px phones
Owner withdraws news from public views and retains private history
Guest news stays private until approved in the shared TEB queue beside calendar revisions
TEB rejection requires a reason and the real private receipt shows feedback
Old approval links lead to the single TEB queue
Invitation accepted by matching email without manager privileges
Revocation affects an existing session
Print starts with no preselected events and requires manual review

Editing print text invalidates the proof and finalization
Saving print-specific text preserves the public event
Newly saved print appears in the archive without a reload
Print editor fits desktop and small phones
Published PDF bytes remain unchanged after event edit
Login, overview, profile editor and access list fit 390px and 320px
Multiple-association users choose only among their own associations
Unassigned accounts request access through the UI and the shared queue requires explicit verification
Unassigned verified users get Contact TEB without editing access
Public pages fit 390px and 320px without horizontal overflow
Det sker preserves media links and Facebook alongside association news; both pages end with Facebook
new calendar screen: one column per day, upcoming events with photos, details without empty fields and print calendar
calendar desktop/mobile layout and month switch
guest creation, visibility wishes, preview and uncertain-response retry preserve one private submission
TEB reviews visibility wishes; approval publishes once; existing private edit retains selected wishes
verified association publishes directly from its own calendar creation link
old guest, public and creation URLs survive the move; former submissions still approve and open private editing
source outage retains previously loaded calendar events and shows a useful status

findings.detail: Creation uses event-composer.js popup. Member and guest editing still use eventForm in kalender.js. Editing preserves the existing image but has no photo replacement/removal control.
forening-v2.css loads after portal.css and forening.css; the newer profile/workspace design overrides the earlier styling.
Redirect pages and kalender-opslag.js retain earlier links/posts. These paths are covered by the calendar browser suite.

Pages post to /api/formular. Calendar pilot server serves the pages but not the form Worker. GET /api/formular/config returned 404 on a fresh isolated pilot server; both form pages returned 200. Unit tests pass with mocked email, without proving actual delivery.
Calendar Worker configuration retains placeholder D1 ID and no production route. Real mail, staging and backup/recovery remain launch work.

architecture.archives: Seven archive/* branches, not active runtime code

limitations: External calendar sources are fixture-backed in browser checks.
Mail adapters are local or mocked.
No live contact/membership submission, staging deployment or production delivery test was performed.
